purpose: Test whether the frozen full-transition future-HARM rankings remain informative under clinically/operationally stricter or looser Dice-loss margins, without any refitting, recalibration, score-direction change, representation change, or target tuning.

margins.interpretation: sensitivity analysis only; no margin is selected as a new primary endpoint

POLYPGEN_MEMO.score: frozen R33A2B full-transition SafeTTA risk score
summary: macro-3 state AUROC/AUPRC if exact state labels are recoverable

bootstrap.invalid_single_class_replicates: drop and report valid count; never replace AUROC with 0.5

frozen_constraints: no cherry-picking a preferred sensitivity margin

reporting.claim_rule: Use sensitivity only to assess robustness of the ranking conclusion. Do not replace the preregistered/frozen -0.02 endpoint.
